identificationModule.briefTitle: Controlled Myelofibrosis Study With Oral Janus-associated Kinase (JAK) Inhibitor Treatment-II: The COMFORT-II Trial
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Study of Ruxolitinib Tablets Compared to Best Available Therapy in Subjects With Primary Myelofibrosis, Post-Polycythemia Vera-Myelofibrosis or Post-Essential Thrombocythemia Myelofibrosis

armGroups.label: Ruxolitinib
armGroups.description: 5 mg tablets administered orally in an outpatient setting according to the protocol-specified dosing schedule

armGroups.label: Best Available Therapy (BAT)
armGroups.description:
Commercially available therapy, oral or parenteral, per manufacturer's instructions and Investigator discretion. BAT included the option of no treatment.

Patients randomized to BAT were eligible to cross over to receive open-label ruxolitinib after a qualifying progression event, if they met the safety criteria. After the primary analysis in January 2011, patients randomized to receive BAT were allowed to cross over to receive ruxolitinib and move to the extension phase of the study without a qualifying progression event.
